en: A black and white historical postcard showing a bustling city square. There is a large building with a clock tower, a main street filled with people, and a parade of uniformed soldiers marching. A prominent equestrian statue stands in the center, and other historical buildings with spires are visible in the background. There are various street lamps, posters, and period-dressed passersby.
